title: Teddy Weatherford and Tate's Theater Band
summary: Levy rates Teddy Weatherford among the tops and they discuss his India recordings and Tate's band.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Yes. Mm-hmm. He didn't have quite the, the improvising technique of Cass. Cass was tremendous. He was really tremendous. And that Teddy Weatherford that you heard, I can speak about, he was, he was among the tops too. It was, but I mean, in those days, it's not like you look back over it, you know. You look back and you remember how it was. In those days, we knew it was good, and we didn't, we just said, well, he's going to like to work with him.
Well, Teddy recorded some piano solos in India.
Now, you hear Teddy a little bit on one or two records that was made by the theater band.
Oh, yeah. Tate's Theater Band. Uh-huh.
I think Louie was in the same band.
